note: Pre-2015 format: Answer any 5 of 10, all 10 marks, ~500 words each

questions.text: Describe Cognitive Psychology as it is today. Discuss the main domains of Cognitive Psychology.
Describe the development of memory with reference to information processing.
Critically evaluate the level of processing model of memory.
Define intelligence and present a critical appraisal of two factor theory of intelligence.
Describe the development of Stanford Binet Scales. Explain the structure and interpretation of Stanford-Binet Scales.
Explain the meaning and aspects of creativity and describe how creativity is related to intelligence.
What are the different processes involved in language comprehension?
What are the functions of language? Discuss structure of language.
What are the role of various type of thinking involved in solving different kinds of problems?
